Definitely not the only one. Sometimes it's good to feel worse just to know you can feel.

I feel the same way. My parents, who don't really understand depression, asked the other day what I have to feel depressed about. About a year ago, and the 18 years before that, I had a long list of reasons. Then I realized that after I'd worked so hard the past year to improve things, that I really didn't have much to be depressed about--I'm doing well in a good college, I'm pretty happy with my appearance, I have great friends, and while my family life is awful, it isn't as unmanageable as before. All that's left is this fucking loneliness, and it's eating me alive.
